messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-latency-monitor p99 > 1.2s for route /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Paging oncall @alex. Automatic paging rule: p99_threshold_breach.

alex: ack — I'm oncall, pulling dashboards now.

alex: quick check: can anyone confirm if there's a deploy in the last 30m? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy finished by @ingrid at 1985004100 — service: runtime-service, image: inference:v2.14. Start->end 1985004068-1985004100.

priya: I see spike on the p95/p99 panel, tail is drifting up around 12:20 UTC. Streaming stall alerts also firing for some sessions.

ingrid: looking at runtime logs for us-west-2. Seeing a lot of `KVCache eviction` + `context_length mismatch` warnings around the same time. Could be cache churn under new batching heuristics.

alex: good lead. priya — can you confirm if autoscaler bumped capacity or hit any soft limits?

priya: checking metrics -> autoscaler didn't add new workers in last 15m. Pool utilization hovered ~92% for GPUs. There are a handful of long requests with >500 tokens.

sam: flagging customer-impact: CS dashboard shows 3 active customers with elevated error-free latency, major user sessions in prod region. Not yet SLA breach for any single customer but trending. pinging CS leads.

alex: timeline so far: deploy 1985004100, p99 climb detected 1985004321, KV evictions starting ~1985004300. Hypothesis: new batching heuristics + longer contexts increased KV cache thrash -> tail waits to rebuild cache causing stalls.

ingrid: I can quickly rollback batching tweak on canary if we want to test mitigation. Would take ~2-3m to flip config on canary route and 5-7m for traffic migration.

alex: do it. Also create immediate fallback route to smaller model variant (quantized) for heavy sessions to reduce per-token latency. Command to create fallback:

```bash
# create fallback policy
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route /v1/generate --model rwd-q4f-small --priority 10 --ttl 300
```

priya: running quick queries against traces: p99 latency traces show worker queue wait spikes, not pure compute. Points to scheduling/queuing at runtime layer.

ingrid: canary flip started. I'll post when route config is updated.

deploy-bot: canary-config update pushed at 1985004385 by ingrid.

alex: toggled fallback route command executed. Monitoring now.

priya: initial signal: p99 dropped from 1.35s -> 0.95s on canary traffic subset. Tail stalls reduced. :thumbsup:

sam: customer-impact update: the three customers saw median latency improve on fallback route, one reported intermittent streaming stalls are resolved. I'll open tickets for the affected customers with timeline.

alex: great. Next steps: 1) keep fallback and canary in place for 30m; 2) gather traces for a few of the long requests that hit eviction; 3) schedule rollback of batching heuristic if further evidence.

priya: saving traces: query used: `service:runtime AND env:prod AND region:us-west-2 AND trace.duration>1000ms` — pulling full spans and KV-cache metrics.

ingrid: found root cause indicator: change in batch formation caused hot keys to rotate frequently leading to TTL-based eviction. Patch ready that pins hot-key routing for the next week. Will open a PR and can patch the canary.

alex: thanks. For oncall handoff: I'm going offline in 20m, priya will take over. priya — you on shift?

priya: I got it. Taking ownership. I'll monitor for 1h and run the rollback if we see reversion.

alex: pinging #postmortems and #product — tagging for customer comms later. :bell:

sam: tickets created for customers C-1284, C-1291, C-1302 with impact notes and mitigation steps. Will coordinate emails if needed.

priya: recording incident notes /incident/1985004321 — initial mitigation succeeded, fallback + canary reduced p99. Need to validate patch on canary and plan full rollback of batching heuristic or patch to hot-key routing.

ingrid: PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5423 — patch to pin hot-key routing. Marking as urgent for post-incident review.

deploy-bot: reminder: leave canary and fallback config until post-incident signoff.

alex: closing loop — post-incident huddle at 1985006400 UTC (approx). Priya leading the handoff. Thanks everyone. :heart:
summary: Realtime p99 latency spike in us-west-2; initial detection via incident-bot. Deploy around same time; KV cache evictions suspected. Canary rollback of batching heuristics and enabling fallback model reduced p99 from ~1.35s to ~0.95s. Oncall handoff to priya; customer tickets opened. Patch PR created to pin hot-key routing.
